item.title: The musical roadtrip of Where's West? makes a stop in San Luis Obispo - KCPR
item.description: The band officially formed in 2022 at Chapman University, but its roots go back further. Vocalist and guitarist Zan Curleigh and Hauser grew up near each other in the Bay Area before reconnecting in college. At first, it wasn’t a formal project— just two friends plugging in and playing.

item.title: Tips for picking out your St. Fratty's Day outfit - KCPR
item.description: When spring blooms in San Luis Obispo, it means Saint Patrick’s Day and the annual St. Fratty’s Day celebration is right around the corner. As Cal Poly students and local residents anticipate the arrival of the town’s most iconic yet contentious holiday celebration, here is a guide to looking stylish while celebrating at 3:17 a.m and beyond.

item.title: 311 makes their San Luis Obispo debut at the Madonna Expo Center - KCPR
item.description: 311’s stop at the Madonna Inn was a part of “The Road to 311 Day,” a series of three shows in California leading up to the band’s 26th annual celebration. This year, the 311 Day festival was held over March 7 and March 8 in Las Vegas.
